questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Consider the following statements:
In statically determinate structures,
1. Conditions of equilibrium are sufficient to fully analyse the structure.
2. The bending moment at a section or the force in a member depends upon the material of the components of the structure.
3. Stresses are generally caused due to temperature variations.
4. Stresses are caused due to lack of fit
Which of the above statement(s) is (are) CORRECT?
questions.questionText: Consider the following statements: In statically determinate structures, 1. Conditions of equilibrium are sufficient to fully analyse the structure. 2. The bending moment at a section or the force in a member depends upon the material of the components of the structure. 3. Stresses are generally caused due to temperature variations. 4. Stresses are caused due to lack of fit Which of the above statement(s) is (are) CORRECT?
questions.explanationHtml:
(a)
In a determinate structure, the bending moment at a section or the force in any member is
independent of the material of the components of the structure.
No stresses are caused due to temperature changes.
No stresses are caused due to lack of fit.

questions.explanationHtml:

A symmetric parabolic arch either two hinged or three hinged is always free from bending moment
and radial shear and it is only subjected to normal thrust when it carries uniformly distributed
load over the entire span.

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following options are correct related to structural analysis?
questions.questionText: Which of the following options are correct related to structural analysis?

options.html: Flexibility matrix and its transpose are equal.
options.text: Flexibility matrix and its transpose are equal.

options.html: Flexibility matrix may not be a square matrix.
options.text: Flexibility matrix may not be a square matrix.

options.html: Elements of main diagonal of stiffness matrix are always positive.
options.text: Elements of main diagonal of stiffness matrix are always positive.

options.html: For unstable structure, coefficient in leading diagonal of flexibility matrix can be negative.
options.text: For unstable structure, coefficient in leading diagonal of flexibility matrix can be negative.

questions.explanationHtml:
(a, c)
Flexibility matrix is equal to its transpose as it is a square matrix and its elements are symmetrical
about diagonal.
Elements of main diagonal of stiffness matrix are always positive as displacement will always
occur in direction of force applied at a point.
Structure has to be stable and in equilibrium to develop flexibility matrix.
